product: Carpe 100HR Sweat & Odor Control Antiperspirant Deodorant, Vanilla Peach, 1.76 oz (lotion, twist knob)

refs.hand: refs/hand_dorsal.png + refs/hand_palm.png (crops of refs/hand_sheet.jpg; annotation text is NOT part of the image)

still_model: nano-banana-pro on Kie, 1K, 9:16, refs = hand_dorsal, hand_palm, product_front, product_open (+ shot S2 still as the room ref for every later still)
video_model: bytedance/seedance-2-mini on Kie, first_frame_url = the approved still, generate_audio: false, 720p, 9:16
identity_block: The hand is the ONLY person in the video: one woman's hands, medium-dark brown skin, slim fingers, long squared nails with a glossy pale lilac-white base and a narrow white tip band on every nail, exactly as in the hand reference images (ignore the annotation text and leader lines in those images). No face, no arms above the forearm, no other people. The product is exactly the Carpe stick in the product reference images: bright orange oval twist-up stick, rounded orange cap with a white '100Hr CLINICALLY TESTED' shield badge, large white vertical 'carpe' wordmark, white panel reading 'VANILLA PEACH', white domed formula under the cap, orange twist knob at the base. Keep the hand and product identical in every frame: no morphing, no extra fingers, no changing nail colour, no label drift.
scene_block: Setting: a real bathroom vanity in the morning, warm cream countertop, soft window light from the left, a small round mirror edge and a folded white towel slightly out of focus. Shot on a phone, handheld, natural light, realistic unretouched skin texture with visible knuckle creases, authentic UGC look, no cinematic grading. No on-screen text or captions. No other branded products.
video_suffix: Camera: handheld phone, gentle natural shake, no zoom unless stated. Fingers move naturally and stay anatomically correct (five fingers per hand). The label stays upright and readable. No sound. No on-screen text.

shots.vo: Wait. I was not expecting my deodorant to be a lotion.
shots.still: Extreme close-up, eye level. One hand holds the uncapped Carpe stick upright near the bottom, the white domed formula on top facing the lens; the other hand's thumb and index finger grip the orange twist knob at the base. Cap lies on the counter behind.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the thumb and index finger twist the orange knob at the base twice; a small glossy bead of white lotion slowly rises through the top of the dome. The hand tilts the stick a few degrees toward the lens to show it.

shots.vo: This is Carpe, and it's clinically tested to control sweat and odor for up to one hundred hours.
shots.still: Medium close-up. The hand holds the capped Carpe stick upright at chest height in front of the vanity, front label squarely facing the camera: 'carpe' wordmark, VANILLA PEACH panel and the '100Hr CLINICALLY TESTED' badge on the cap all sharp and readable.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-3s): the hand lifts the stick from the counter into frame and turns it so the front label faces the lens. Shot 2 (3-6s): slow handheld push-in toward the 100Hr badge on the cap while the index fingernail taps the badge once.
shots.insert: 0.8s label close-up cropped from this still (zoompan), laid over the word 'one hundred hours' so the badge reads sharp

shots.vo: You twist the bottom, a little lotion comes up, and you rub it in.
shots.still: Top-down overhead shot of the vanity. Both hands: the left hand holds the uncapped stick, the right thumb is on the orange twist knob. The cap lies beside a folded white towel.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-2s): the right thumb turns the twist knob; lotion beads on the dome. Shot 2 (2-4s): the right index fingertip touches the dome, lifts off a small dab and rubs it between fingertip and thumb.

shots.vo: It goes on clear and dries fast.
shots.still: Macro close-up of the right thumb and index fingertip pressed together with a small dab of white lotion between them, against the soft cream vanity background.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the fingertips rub together in small circles; the white lotion spreads thin and turns completely clear and invisible, leaving a soft matte finish. The fingers part to show no residue.

shots.vo: No chalky stick, no white streaks on my black tee.
shots.still: Close-up of a neatly folded plain black cotton t-shirt on the vanity, completely clean with no marks; the hand rests flat on it, the Carpe stick standing upright beside it.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand smooths the black t-shirt flat with one slow stroke, then lifts the folded edge to show the fabric is clean, with no white marks anywhere.

shots.vo: And Vanilla Peach? It smells like peach cobbler.
shots.still: Close-up on the vanity: the uncapped Carpe stick stands next to one ripe peach and a single dark vanilla bean; the hand rests beside them.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand picks up the peach, gives it a gentle playful squeeze, sets it back next to the stick, then wafts the air above the stick toward the camera with relaxed fingers.

shots.vo: No parabens, no baking soda, no talc, and it's vegan.
shots.still: Close-up. The hand holds the stick turned around so the back panel faces the camera: orange back with a white Drug Facts panel and a barcode label; the index fingernail rests on the panel.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the index fingernail taps down the Drug Facts panel three times, moving lower with each tap, then the hand turns the stick back to the front label.

shots.vo: Grab it from the orange cart before your next sweaty day.
shots.still: Medium close-up of the vanity: the capped Carpe stick stands centred, front label facing the camera; the hand hovers just above it.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-2s): the hand sets the stick down centred and taps the cap twice. Shot 2 (2-4s): the hand points down toward the bottom-left corner of the frame and holds the point.

alt_hooks.vo: If your deodorant gives up before lunch, you need to see this.
alt_hooks.still: Close-up of a small bathroom trash can beside the vanity; the hand holds a plain unbranded white deodorant stick over it.
alt_hooks.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand drops the plain white stick into the trash can, then reaches up and picks the orange Carpe stick off the counter into frame.

alt_hooks.vo: Every black top I own had white streaks on it. Until this.
alt_hooks.still: Close-up of the hand holding up the shoulder of a plain black t-shirt that has two chalky white deodorant streaks near the armhole.
alt_hooks.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand rubs at the white streaks with a fingertip, then drops the shirt and picks up the orange Carpe stick into frame.

alt_hooks.vo: One hundred hours of sweat and odor protection. In a deodorant.
alt_hooks.still: Extreme close-up of the Carpe cap: the '100Hr CLINICALLY TESTED' shield badge fills the frame, the index fingernail resting under it.
alt_hooks.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the fingernail taps the 100Hr badge twice, then the camera pulls back as the hand turns the stick to show the whole front label.

alt_hooks.vo: Over ten million of these have sold, so I finally tried one.
alt_hooks.still: Close-up of a plain kraft paper mailer on the vanity, torn open at the top; the hand reaches in.
alt_hooks.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand slides the orange Carpe stick out of the mailer and holds it up to the lens, label facing the camera.
